meta.name: Adolescencia
meta.description: Cuando un chico de 13 años es acusado de asesinar a una compañera de clase, su familia, su terapeuta y el detective a cargo se preguntan qué pasó en realidad.
meta.country: United Kingdom, United States of America

videos.title: Episodio 1
videos.overview: La policía derriba la puerta del hogar de los Miller. El adolescente Jamie es arrestado y llevado a la comisaría para un interrogatorio, pero insiste en que no ha hecho nada malo.

videos.title: Episodio 2
videos.overview: La policía busca respuestas —y el arma homicida— en la escuela de Jamie. No obtienen información de los amigos del chico, hasta que el hijo del detective Bascombe ofrece su ayuda.

videos.title: Episodio 3
videos.overview: Jamie se reúne con una psicóloga. Al principio, no quiere hablar, pero después se sincera sobre sus complejos sentimientos hacia Katie.

videos.title: Episodio 4
videos.overview: En el cumpleaños de Eddie, los Miller intentan festejar como si todo estuviera bien, pero una serie de sucesos imprevistos amenaza con desestabilizarlos.

videos.title: The Making of Adolescence: The One-Shot Explained
videos.overview: Go in-depth with the cast & crew of Adolescence as they explain and uncover the inspiration behind the story and see how they pulled off the incredible four continuous takes that make this series a must-watch.

videos.title: Inside Episode 1: The Arrest
videos.overview: The cast and crew of the Netflix series Adolescence explore the one-shot format in episode 1 of the series.

videos.title: Inside Episode 2: The School
videos.overview: The cast and crew of the Netflix series Adolescence explore the structure of the one-shot format in episode 2 of the series.

videos.title: Inside Episode 3: The Boy
videos.overview: The cast and crew discuss the origins of the series and the filming of the Netflix series, Adolescence during the powerful episode 3.

videos.title: Inside Episode 4: The Family
videos.overview: Go behind the scenes of the powerful one-shot episode as the team breaks down the importance of the cast, crew, and location.

videos.title: Interview with Stephen Graham & Jack Thorn
(One) Shot By Shot with Erin Doherty & Owen Coope
videos.overview: Adolescence's Owen Cooper and Erin Doherty take us through what it was really like to shoot episode 3 of Adolescence all in one shot.

videos.title: Stephen Graham & Ashley Walters Go Fishing and Talk Adolescence
videos.overview: Adolescence stars Stephen and Ashley take to waders like a fish takes to water. The two old friends hang out for the day to give fishing a try, and then head to a local cinema to watch back scenes from Adolescence.
